cohort: 131 mothers who gave birth vaginally and 94 who gave birth by caesarean section at a hospital in Istanbul, Turkey.
finding: There was no significant difference in privacy perception scores between mothers who gave birth vaginally and those who gave birth by caesarean section, but mothers who gave birth by caesarean section were more satisfied with their birth experience.
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth by caesarean section were more satisfied than those who gave birth vaginally.
